name: Silence Skipper
author: zysilm
punchline: Skips the silent stretches of lectures and recordings while they play
description: Silence Skipper jumps over the pauses in a video or audio file on this computer, like Trim Silence in podcast players: lectures, talks, screen recordings and interviews play without the dead air. Playback ▸ Skip Silence turns it on and off. While it is on, the player's FFmpeg reads the sound of the playing file two minutes at a time, starting where you are, and each silence that is long enough is skipped with a jump; the seek bar shows the silences it found, and a short note on the video says how much time skipping has saved. Options ▸ Playback ▸ Silence Skipper sets how quiet counts as silence and the shortest pause that is skipped. Speech is never sped up, and a pause at the very end of the file is kept.
